objective: Repair the three independently confirmed portability and version-evolution blockers in the0.3.4 release slice.
constraints: Same HolyAgent implementation role and prior authorization. Work /workspace/work/holyagent-034, sourcehead e289908; user requested0.3.4 release. Root owns VCS/state; no .git/.holyagent/security-setting/remote changes. Read independent reports flow-review-{code,security,testing,artifact}.md outside repo. Repair only the evidenced findings.

1) dev-version.sh uses GNU date -d but tests run under macOS BSD date. Use portable UTC timestamp derivation available in both production action and native test hosts. Prefer Git's own UTC formatting over adding a new runtime dependency; release tagging job does not install Bun, so don't silently require it. Preserve deterministic commit-time+SHA SemVer and existing protected tag prefix.

2) Date conversion failure masked in printf command substitution produces0.3.4-dev..gHASH with exit0. Assign/validate intermediate values and fail closed for missing/invalid commit metadata/conversion; add a controlled red/green regression reproducing the masked failure, without relying on a live macOS machine. Test portability through a non-GNU-date environment/fixture, not by skipping macOS tests.

3) publishing.test.ts hardcodes0.3.4. Derive root version or use an isolated version fixture and demonstrate next bump's expected behavior, preserving the only-root-version convention. Do not mutate root version manually or weaken branch/version contracts.
